name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan’s journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a deep fascination with fluid dynamics and engineering. After graduating from the National University of Singapore with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, she worked for several years in the aerospace industry, developing her expertise in aerodynamics. The challenge of optimizing performance within the constraints of motorsport regulations drew her to VW Racing Brasil. 

As Head of Aero, Mei Lian emphasizes a data-driven approach combined with practical trackside observations. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers from different disciplines can freely exchange ideas. Her focus is always on finding innovative solutions that provide a competitive edge while maintaining reliability. What sets Mei Lian apart is her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to distill complex technical concepts into easily understandable terms for the entire team.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with streaks of grey
physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a practical bun
physical.description: Mei Lian is of average height with a thoughtful expression and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking a cup of strong kopi (Singaporean coffee) before every race.
